name: UVMulti
description: Multi-task learning has shown great potential in promoting the performance of multiple underwater vision tasks and has attracted increasing attention. However, the lack of large-scale underwater multi-task learning datasets with multi-task ground truth annotations has limited the research and development of underwater multi-task learning. To address this issue, we introduce the first large-scale high-resolution underwater video-level multi-task learning benchmark (UVMulti) to promote the development of underwater multi-task learning, which contains 100 video sequences with 87,352 frames.
